What changed

Three drivers explain the margin step-up

  • Pricing discipline lifted gross margin by 2.0 pts
  • Mix shift toward higher-margin components, with SKU-7 now 31% of revenue
  • Operating leverage: opex grew 10.4%, slower than gross profit1
  • Interest expense fell as debt was repaid early
Gross profit grew 17.4% on revenue growth of 10.7%, the clearest sign the pricing actions held.
“The plan is funded from operating cash, not new debt.”

— CFO, board pre-read

1. Excluding one-off restructuring costs.
